contexts.text: Man... would not act from freedom according to reason; nor would anything appear to him as his... if he foreknew events. General article. DP 178.

As the foreknowledge of future things takes away the human itself, which is to act from freedom according to reason, no one is permitted to know future things... The desire to foreknow future things is connate with most people, but this desire originates from a love of evil. It is therefore taken away from those who believe in the Divine Providence, and there is given them trust that the Lord disposes their lot; consequently they do not want to foreknow it, lest in some way they should interfere with the Divine Providence.
